en: An old green Italian postal card with printed postage showing a portrait of an Italian monarch in an ornate frame at the upper left and the coat of arms of the Kingdom of Italy (Savoy shield with crown and crossed flags) in the center. The card bears black ink handwriting addressed to a person in Spain and a circular cancellation mark reading "FIRENZE" with a date. Italian printed text appears at the top and bottom of the card, and the denomination "CENTESIMI DIECI" is indicated.
